title: Full evidence producer accepts mutable supply-chain inputs
protocol: runtime evidence and CI dependency provenance
profile: Parent PR #74 strict/full verified report workflow
summary: The newly activated strict/full runtime producer resolved Expat from a mutable latest-release endpoint and used an unpinned Python bootstrap before evidence production.
summary_de: Der neu aktivierte strikte/vollständige Runtime-Producer löste Expat über einen veränderlichen Latest-Release-Endpunkt auf und verwendete vor der Evidence-Produktion einen ungepinnten Python-Bootstrap.
observed_behavior: The PR #74 workflow change invokes make verified-report-run. Its mandatory component preparation resolved Expat through GitHub releases/latest, while the newly added make setup-dev step upgraded Pip and installed range-based PyYAML.
observed_behavior_de: Die PR-#74-Workflow-Änderung ruft make verified-report-run auf. Dessen verpflichtende Komponenten-Vorbereitung löste Expat über GitHub releases/latest auf, während der neu hinzugefügte Schritt make setup-dev Pip aktualisierte und bereichsbasiertes PyYAML installierte.
expected_behavior: Every mandatory producer input must be fixed to an immutable reviewed identity before evidence is accepted; Python dependency installation must be hash-locked.
expected_behavior_de: Jede verpflichtende Producer-Eingabe muss vor der Evidence-Akzeptanz auf eine unveränderliche überprüfte Identität festgelegt sein; die Python-Abhängigkeitsinstallation muss hash-gesperrt erfolgen.
impact: The runtime evidence chain would not be reproducibly provenance-bound, so a strict-gate pass could not provide the intended assurance. No GitHub permission or gate bypass was observed.
impact_de: Die Runtime-Evidence-Kette wäre nicht reproduzierbar an ihre Provenienz gebunden; ein Strict-Gate-Pass könnte die beabsichtigte Assurance nicht liefern. Es wurde kein GitHub-Berechtigungs- oder Gate-Bypass beobachtet.
preconditions: PR #74 activates make verified-report-run in verified-report-governance.yml.
The mandatory full producer prepares runtime components and installs its Python dependency path.
reproduction: Inspect the make setup-dev workflow step and Framework bootstrap-python.sh/requirements-dev.txt.

evidence.command: Focused source-to-sink security review of the uncommitted PR #74 workflow remediation
Focused strict-Expat, workflow-security, tool-lock, bilingual-documentation, and whitespace validation

root_cause: The mandatory Expat call reused a helper designed to resolve latest releases at runtime, and the workflow used the general development bootstrap rather than the existing hash-locked Framework CI dependency contract.
root_cause_de: Der verpflichtende Expat-Aufruf verwendete einen Helper zur Laufzeitauflösung aktueller Releases erneut, und der Workflow nutzte den allgemeinen Entwicklungs-Bootstrap statt des vorhandenen hash-gesperrten Framework-CI-Abhängigkeitsvertrags.
proposed_remediation: Use a Parent verifier that accepts only an exact Expat commit and sets it from the reviewed workflow, then replace make setup-dev with a selected-Python virtual environment that installs Framework requirements-ci.lock using --require-hashes and --only-binary.
proposed_remediation_de: Einen Parent-Verifier verwenden, der nur einen exakten Expat-Commit akzeptiert und ihn aus dem überprüften Workflow setzt; anschließend make setup-dev durch eine Selected-Python-virtuelle Umgebung ersetzen, die Framework requirements-ci.lock mit --require-hashes und --only-binary installiert.
acceptance_criteria: The Expat strict path rejects a branch, tag, empty ref, or latest-release lookup.
The reviewed full Expat commit is checked out and recorded exactly.
The workflow uses requirements-ci.lock with --require-hashes and no Pip upgrade or requirements-dev installation.
Focused source and workflow tests pass.
A fresh exact-head strict/full runtime run and terminal evidence gate pass.
validation_plan: Run the focused prepare-runtime-components and CI workflow contract suites.
Run a fresh exact-head hosted full producer and terminal strict gate.
Inspect exact-head CI, SonarCloud, review threads, and resulting master evidence before closure.
legitimate_control_tests: The verified R_2_8_2 Expat commit is accepted and recorded without a latest-release lookup.
The exact CPython 3.14 Framework lock installs with its reviewed wheel hash and pip check.
blocked_by: Exact-head hosted strict/full runtime evidence and terminal-gate validation are pending.
residual_risk: Until the parent fix and exact-head full evidence run pass, the strict producer could consume mutable source or dependency inputs. The gate remains fail-closed; no risk is accepted.
residual_risk_de: Bis Parent-Korrektur und Exact-Head-Full-Evidence-Lauf bestanden sind, könnte der strikte Producer veränderliche Source- oder Dependency-Eingaben konsumieren. Das Gate bleibt fehlgeschlossen; es wird kein Risiko akzeptiert.

history.detail: Independent source-to-sink review found mandatory mutable Expat and Python bootstrap inputs in the proposed strict/full producer. The normal push was suspended; no control was weakened.

The strict producer now supplies a hash-locked Framework CI dependency and an immutable Expat commit. Focused Parent tests, workflow/tool-lock validation, bilingual documentation, and whitespace validation passed. Publication and exact-head hosted full evidence remain required.
